sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United, who sit top of the table with 28 points from 12 games and have won four of their last five league matches, travel to Bilston Town on Saturday. Bilston are second in the table, just two points behind Sandbach, and bring excellent form of their own with four consecutive wins. This is a direct title-race encounter between the division's two strongest sides.
divisionWide: The second-place battle extends beyond the Sandbach-Bilston clash: Stafford Town (third, 24 points) host Brereton Social, while AFC Bridgnorth (fourth, 23 points) visit Barnton (sixth, 21 points), creating several opportunities for the chasing pack to close the gap on the leaders. Wolverhampton Casuals, fifth on 22 points, travel to Telford Town (bottom, 7 points) in what should be a comfortable affair for the visitors. Mid-table sides face various tests: Eccleshall host Crewe, New Mills visit Alsager Town (who are winless in their last six league matches), Shawbury United entertain Cheadle Heath Nomads, Allscott Heath host Foley Meir, Wednesfield Community welcome Market Drayton Town, and Widnes Town travel to Dawley Town. Alsager Town continue to struggle at the bottom of the standings.
